verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The new flat-manifest gate derives repeated variable slots from the verifier-parsed query, checks every active row of each constant-compatible scan using canonical field equality, and remains disabled only on the extended-fragment path where variable-name-keyed solution/coherence binding already enforces the same invariant. The negative witness exercises the real prefilter entry point and pins the structured rejection, while the genuine self-loop and distinct-variable controls make the test non-vacuous and guard scope. The audit and skill text retain the research-grade, not-externally-audited caveat. No correctness, soundness, security, test-validity, or injection issue was found.
